answer: Agents bidding on bridge-inspection or opal-grading jobs join only if a ledger account aged 15+ epochs sponsors them. Each account sponsors once per 8 epochs and locks 30 credits, doubling for every live agent it backs. A randomness beacon picks audit items, and the contract slashes sponsors whose agents repeat the same wrong answers. Account age and elapsed epochs can't be minted or run in parallel, so each next fake waits longer and stakes more.
